title: Broadest evacuation order for Lebanon issued by Israeli army
summary: The Israeli military ordered the ​evacuation of ‌a swathe of southern Lebanon on March 4th, asking residents to move north. This evacuation is the broadest evacuation order yet in this new conflict. Meanwhile, Syria has closed its border with Lebanon after a warning it would be targeted by Israe. FRANCE 24's Renee Davis has more from Beirut.
